nodes.name: 2. Get Video Processing Records
nodes.notes: Finds all Reel Engine records in Video Processing status

nodes.name: 3. Extract HeyGen Job ID
nodes.notes: Parses the HeyGen Job ID from the HeyGen_Video_ID field or Reel_Notes fallback. Stale detection removed — HeyGen response is the source of truth.

nodes.name: 4. Has HeyGen ID?
nodes.notes: Only proceeds if a valid HeyGen Job ID was found. Skips records with no ID.

nodes.name: 5. Re-check HeyGen Status
nodes.notes: Calls HeyGen API to get current render status for the job

nodes.name: 7. Status Switch
nodes.notes: Routes to: Video Ready (complete), Error (failed), or leaves as Video Processing (still rendering)

nodes.name: 8a. Mark Video Ready
nodes.notes: Video is done — saves URL and sets Status = Video Ready. Reel_Notes left untouched to preserve production brief.

nodes.name: 8b. Mark HeyGen Error
nodes.notes: HeyGen reported a failure — marks as Failed so team can review and re-submit

nodes.name: 8c. Still Processing — Wait
nodes.notes: Video is still rendering. No action needed — this workflow runs every 5 minutes and will check again automatically.

nodes.name: 7a2. Fetch Current Record
nodes.notes: Re-reads the record right before uploading. WF06 may have already completed this render and written the Drive URL while this retry run was in flight.

nodes.name: 7a4. Already Completed?
nodes.notes: True = WF06 already uploaded and marked this record Video Ready. Skip to avoid a duplicate Drive folder and a second upload.
